sentences.text: Heinrich Luitpold Himmler -LRB- -LSB- ˈhaɪnʁɪç ˈluˑɪtˌpɔlt ˈhɪmlɐ -RSB- ; 7 October 1900 -- 23 May 1945 -RRB- was Reichsführer of the Schutzstaffel -LRB- Protection Squadron ; SS -RRB- , and a leading member of the Nazi Party -LRB- NSDAP -RRB- of Germany .	Germany	Nazi Germany	Reichsführer	Reichsführer-SS	Schutzstaffel	Schutzstaffel	Nazi Party	Nazi Party

Nazi leader Adolf Hitler briefly appointed him a military commander and later Commander of the Replacement -LRB- Home -RRB- Army and General Plenipotentiary for the administration of the entire Third Reich -LRB- Generalbevollmächtigter für die Verwaltung -RRB- .	Adolf Hitler	Adolf Hitler	General Plenipotentiary	Plenipotentiary
Himmler was one of the most powerful men in Nazi Germany and one of the people most directly responsible for the Holocaust .	Germany	Nazi Germany	the Holocaust	the Holocaust
As a member of a reserve battalion during World War I , Himmler did not see active service .	World War I	World War I
He studied agronomy in college , and joined the Nazi Party in 1923 and the SS in 1925 .	Nazi Party	Nazi Party	agronomy	agronomy
In 1929 , he was appointed Reichsführer-SS by Hitler .	Reichsführer-SS	Reichsführer-SS	Reichsführer	Reichsführer-SS

Over the next 16 years , he developed the SS from a mere 290-man battalion into a million-strong paramilitary group , and , following Hitler 's orders , set up and controlled the Nazi concentration camps .	Nazi concentration camps	Nazi concentration camps
He was known to have good organisational skills and for selecting highly competent subordinates , such as Reinhard Heydrich in 1931 .	Reinhard Heydrich	Reinhard Heydrich

From 1943 onwards , he was both Chief of German Police and Minister of the Interior , overseeing all internal and external police and security forces , including the Gestapo -LRB- Secret State Police -RRB- .	Gestapo	Gestapo

Himmler had a lifelong interest in occultism , interpreting Germanic neopagan and Völkisch beliefs to promote the racial policy of Nazi Germany , and incorporating esoteric symbolism and rituals into the SS .	Germany	Nazi Germany	Germanic neopagan	Neopaganism in German-speaking Europe	Völkisch	Völkisch movement	racial policy of Nazi Germany	racial policy of Nazi Germany	esoteric	Western esotericism
On Hitler 's behalf , Himmler formed the Einsatzgruppen and built extermination camps .	Einsatzgruppen	Einsatzgruppen

As facilitator and overseer of the concentration camps , Himmler directed the killing of some six million Jews , between 200,000 and 500,000 Romani people , and other victims ; the total number of civilians killed by the regime is estimated at eleven to fourteen million people .	Jews	Jews	Romani people	Romani people
Most of them were Polish and Soviet citizens .	Polish	World War II crimes in Poland	Soviet	World War II casualties of the Soviet Union

Late in World War II , Hitler charged Himmler with the command of the Army Group Upper Rhine and the Army Group Vistula ; he failed to achieve his assigned objectives and Hitler replaced him in these posts .	Army Group Upper Rhine	Army Group Oberrhein (Germany)	Army Group Vistula	Army Group Vistula
Realising that the war was lost , he attempted to open peace talks with the western Allies without Hitler 's knowledge shortly before the war ended .	Allies	Allies of World War II
Hearing of this , Hitler dismissed him from all his posts in April 1945 and ordered his arrest .
Himmler attempted to go into hiding , but was detained and then arrested by British forces once his identity became known .
While in British custody , he committed suicide on 23 May 1945 .
